messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: SEV2 - Elevated 502/504 errors detected at edge -> gateway. Alert: 502 rate > 4% (5m) for prod. Affected route: POST /v1/generate. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/edge-errors
miguel_oncall: On it. Paging SREs and infra. I'm taking oncall. Please post anything you try. @kate_eng @tyler_infra @lina_pm
kate_eng: Looking at logs - lots of upstream 'prematurely closed connection' and 504s from nginx. Correlates with spike in total connections. Could be connection storm or upstream pod restart. Sample nginx error:
```
2026/03/15 08:07:22 [error] 1234#0: *98765 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.1.5, server: , request: "POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1", upstream: "http://10.2.3.4:8080/", host: "api.redwood.ai"
```
kate_eng: Quick repro via curl shows intermittent 502s:
```
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer x...' -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
tyler_infra: Observing spike in SYN backlog for model-gw ASG. CPU fine, but sockets are piling up - many CLOSE_WAIT/TIME_WAIT. Possible ephemeral port/socket exhaustion or keepalive misconfiguration. Quick mitigations: enable fallback routing to model-gw-burst pool and scale up ASG. I'll run config changes now.
tyler_infra: Commands to apply:
```
infra routing set-weight --pool model-gw --fallback model-gw-burst --weight 0.2
infra autoscale set --asg model-gw-ASG --desired 6
```
miguel_oncall: Go for it. Kate, can you confirm whether model-gw pods are OOMing or restarting?
kate_eng: No OOMs; no restarts. Just a lot of sockets in CLOSE_WAIT and upstream timeouts. Edge times out after 10s currently which is borderline. Suggest temporarily bumping proxy timeout to 20s while we stabilize.
tyler_infra: I'll bump edge timeout and start canary rollout (5% -> 100%). Deploying now. @deploy-bot initiate canary.
deploy-bot: Started rollout: edge-proxy/nginx-config v2026.03.15-01 -> canary 5%
charlie_sre: Monitoring logs and error rate. If routing + timeout bump reduces 502s we keep. Otherwise prepare to shift traffic to hosted-fallback region.
kate_eng: Weight adjust applied. ASG scaled to desired 6. Edge config canary at 15% now.
miguel_oncall: Observability update: 502 rate fell from 4.8% -> 0.9% over 3 minutes. Errors concentrated in eu-west-1. Estimated customer-impact ~1.2% of requests. No large customers reporting widespread failures yet. Should we notify support and sales?
lina_pm: I'll prepare a short support note with impacted endpoints and mitigation steps. @miguel_oncall please confirm timeframe and update cadence.
miguel_oncall: ETA to stable: 15-20m. I'll update every 10m. Next update 08:30 UTC.
kate_eng: Adding postmortem stub in #postmortems to capture follow-ups (socket reuse, proxy timeouts, autoscale headroom).
miguel_oncall: Handoff plan: I'll stay till 09:00 UTC, then hand off to @charlie_sre. If urgent, call +1-555-0100.
charlie_sre: Acknowledged. If we see regression, revert config and route back.
miguel_oncall: Thanks team. :thumbsup: I'll post an incident summary once stable.
deploy-bot: Canary finished - rollout complete (3m). Edge timeout patch v2026.03.15-01 is live.
miguel_oncall: Confirmed 502 rate steady ~0.5% for last 8 minutes. Customer-impact classified as minor. Moving to monitoring state; creating incident ticket INC-20260315-42 and assigning for postmortem.
lina_pm: Notifying support + sales now. :email:
charlie_sre: Handoff notes: actions taken: routing weight -> 20% fallback, edge timeout increased 10s->20s, ASG desired 4->6. Follow-ups: investigate socket reuse and ephemeral port usage, add e2e keepalive tests, adjust autoscale buffer and run load repro. I'll take next 6-hour oncall.
miguel_oncall: Handoff complete. :white_check_mark:
